```{=html}
<h3>Learning objective</h3>
<p>We are learning to use the scalar product and scalar multiples to calculate angles and identify perpendicular and parallel vectors.</p>
<h3>Success criterion</h3>
<p>I can calculate angles between vectors in 2D and 3D and justify whether vectors are perpendicular or parallel.</p>
```
